items.title: Why Practically Nobody Will Ever End Up in LDS Outer Darkness
items.summary: A Mormon News Roundup YouTube Short looks at the Latter-day Saint idea of outer darkness and why, under church teaching, practically nobody will end up there.

items.title: The First Straw
items.summary: An Exponent II blog post recalls a point when the author was all in on expected sacrifice and then, for probably the first time, thought "But."

items.title: Popular LDS twin influencers draw flak for A.I. use in their memoir. Book is removed from BYU Store website.
items.summary: The Salt Lake Tribune reports that "The Paris Twins," French Latter-day Saint influencers, acknowledged using ChatGPT and Google Translate on their memoir after fellow Latter-day Saints alleged it was largely A.I.-generated. The book was removed from the BYU Store website but remains available on Amazon.

items.title: ‘Mormon’ Trademark Case Pits Church Against Critical Podcaster
items.summary: Bloomberg Law reports that a Utah federal judge was set to hear arguments on whether to dismiss the Church's trademark lawsuit against John Dehlin's Mormon Stories podcast. Dehlin calls the suit a free-speech threat, while the Church's attorney says the issue is "calculated confusion."
